reason: I already take Toplux and reorder it when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. I also forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, and a sachet a day is one more thing to remember.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, 30 foil packets a month, and I already have a brand I reorder.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that it clearly beats my current brand on the lab report, with refill or recyclable packaging instead of foil sachets.
